bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'GAYBBS_RUNTIME_IMAGE_AUDIT
'
printf 'WORKTREE_BASE='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'TRACKED_DIFF_BEGIN
'; git diff -- deploy/gserver-compose.yaml | head -n 110; printf 'TRACKED_DIFF_END
'
printf 'CONTAINER_INSPECT_BEGIN
'
docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format 'NAME={{.Name}} IMAGE={{.Image}} CONFIG_IMAGE={{.Config.Image}} WORKDIR={{.Config.WorkingDir}} CMD={{json .Config.Cmd}} ENTRY={{json .Config.Entrypoint}}' 
printf 'CONTAINER_MOUNTS_BEGIN
'; docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{.Destination}} <- {{.Source}}{{println}}{{end}}'; printf 'CONTAINER_MOUNTS_END
'
printf 'IMAGE_DETAILS_BEGIN
'; docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format 'ID={{.Id}} CREATED={{.Created}} LABELS={{json .Config.Labels}}'; printf 'IMAGE_DETAILS_END
'
printf 'FILES_IN_CONTAINER_BEGIN
'; docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sh -lc 'pwd; ls -l dist/gaybbs.mjs 2>/dev/null || true; ls -l /opt/gaybbs/dist/gaybbs.mjs 2>/dev/null || true'; printf 'FILES_IN_CONTAINER_END
'
printf 'RELEVANT_WORKTREES_BEGIN
'; git worktree list --porcelain | grep -E '^(worktree|HEAD|branch)' | head -n 110; printf 'RELEVANT_WORKTREES_END
'
